_orderUrlStatus:
VERIFIED 2026-08-05 by click-test, all seven. Formerly the biggest launch blocker on the build. Every URL now uses ONE pattern, order.toasttab.com/online/<slug>, which resolves the two-competing-patterns problem (/v2/online-order versus /v3) SITE_ARCHITECTURE.md flagged. It is the same set the 2026-08-04 live catalog pull used, recorded as _source in each src/_data/toastMenus/*.json. Two slugs are knowingly wrong and knowingly kept, see orderUrlNote on crown-point and plaza-bonita: the slug is Toast internal routing, not a NAP value, and editing either one breaks the cart. Maui now has a URL; it previously had none. The Locations mega menu links these directly. /order-online/ remains a real page and reads the same field, so there is still one place to change a URL.

RECONCILED AGAINST GBP 2026-09-09, AND NOTHING CHANGED. Connor's export lists an order-ahead link for four of the six San Diego rooms. Three of the four (Convoy, East Village, Mercury) are bit.ly redirects; this file's direct order.toasttab.com URLs are kept, because a direct link is the stronger value and a shortener adds a hop, a third party, and something that can be retired without warning. The fourth (College Heights) is a direct Toast URL but on the older /v3 pattern with query parameters, against this file's clean /online/ slug; the click-tested value here is kept for the same reason the single-pattern rule exists.

TWO LIVE GAPS ON THE CLIENT'S OWN PROFILES: Crown Point and Plaza Bonita have NO order-ahead link in GBP at all, although both have a working Toast URL in this file. That is revenue leaking on Google, not a site defect. Client action.
